name: FA_TRANSFERS_T
description: FA_TRANSFERS_T contains temporary storage data  for asset transfer transactions.

columns.name: TRANSFER_INTERFACE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset transfer interface row.

columns.name: BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Unique book identification name.

columns.name: ASSET_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset number.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Classification of the distribution transaction. Possible values are TRANSFER when transferring units of an asset and UNIT ADJUSTMENT when adjusting units of an asset.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_DATE_ENTERED
columns.description: Date on which the transaction occurred.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_NAME
columns.description: Description or comments of the transaction.

columns.name: POSTING_STATUS
columns.description: Posting status of the asset transaction.

columns.name: PREPARER_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the person assigned to prepare the mass transaction line

columns.name: INTERFACE_LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Optional number used to link parent and child records when more than one transactions exists on an asset in a given load.

columns.name: CONVENTION_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Prorate convention identifier.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the loader job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
